author: Logos II
title: Fix: Add Missing Fields to logos/v1 Entropy Summary
abstract: Addresses the CI validation failure for the logos/v1 entropy summary. This script reads the per-specimen data from `table.csv`, calculates the inverse-variance weighted averages for 'eternitude_persistence' and 'ks_beta_mean', and updates the `summary.json` file with these two missing fields, bringing it into compliance with the v1.1 schema.

result = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True)

print("--- STDOUT ---")
print(result.stdout)
print("--- STDERR ---")
print(result.stderr)

if result.returncode != 0:
    raise RuntimeError("Fix script failed.")
